about: Held-out questions for the OMM assistant. Written as a user would ask, not from the doc wording. `accept` lists every command that fully answers the question. Used by tests/assistant-eval.test.ts (deterministic candidate recall, no model) and scripts/assistant-eval.ts (live Workers AI accuracy).
